context: Sakura interviews a manager about staffing.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business interview; vocabulary (勤務/バイト/出席/継続/文書) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人手不足は、解決しましたか?
lines.en: Has the staff shortage been solved?
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: バイトを増やして、勤務を回しています。
lines.en: We added part-timers to cover shifts.
lines.style: measured manager voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 勤務の記録は、どう管理しますか?
lines.en: How do you manage work records?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 文書にして、継続的に残します。
lines.en: We put them in documents and keep them continuously.
lines.style: professional manager voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 会議の出席率は、どうですか?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 全員の出席を、目指しています。
lines.style: measured manager voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 良い勤務環境を、継続するコツは?
lines.en: How do you keep a good work environment going?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 文書で、約束を継続することです。
lines.en: It's keeping promises continuously in writing.
lines.style: warm manager voice, soft warm informative closing clarity throughout
